nodes.label: Consistent spacetime rules
nodes.detail: the gravity equations and their built-in redundancies fit together exactly
nodes.next: test the same rules on more backgrounds and boundaries

nodes.label: Cause comes before effect
nodes.detail: signals propagate forward in time in the starting universe, a clock universe, and the first controlled change of a second curved universe
nodes.next: turn the first-order curved change into a full family and add physical boundaries

nodes.label: Equivalent descriptions counted once
nodes.detail: coordinate and scale choices are removed without losing the surviving information
nodes.next: repeat the reduction after boundaries and quantum effects are added

nodes.label: A clock inside the universe
nodes.detail: healthy matter records change while the total time shift remains redundant in the tested sector
nodes.next: test broader clocks and fully backreacted measuring devices

nodes.label: Can a repaired universe keep its clock?
nodes.detail: a changed gravity-clock theory propagates causally, but making time redundant removes its clock; keeping the clock makes time charged, with positive action-angle motion and a rate-dependent phase drift
nodes.next: build the missing squashed-space scalar, vector, tensor and exceptional wave-family maps, then test their pairings and stability before instantiating a receiver

nodes.label: Gravity and light interact
nodes.detail: the first nonlinear laws close exactly for the clock universe and for Einstein gravity coupled to light through third order
nodes.next: build the matching fourth-order-gravity interaction package and compare the two branches

nodes.label: Familiar and extra gravity waves
nodes.detail: both kinds are identified, but the attempted local separation has an exact obstruction
nodes.next: find a larger or differently organized description

nodes.label: Can interactions switch wave types?
nodes.detail: the interaction can be removed at the first tested derivative levels
nodes.next: complete the decisive next-order calculation

nodes.label: Which waves survive nonlinear consistency?
nodes.detail: every finite combination in the complete compact wave catalog continues smoothly exactly when five balances vanish; the global-motion bounded subproblem is solved and two growing directions are universally excluded
nodes.next: finish the oscillator and shell-resonance bounded cone, add infinite-wave inputs, and construct causal continuation

nodes.label: Ordinary relativity inside the model
nodes.detail: a complete linear dictionary separates Einstein-like solutions from their extra companions, while also exposing a mismatch in their standard physical pairings
nodes.next: extend the dictionary to interactions and decide which sector remains closed

nodes.label: Light signals
nodes.detail: electromagnetic signals propagate causally from localized sources
nodes.next: control the complete infinite set of spatial wave patterns

nodes.label: Gravitational waves
nodes.detail: direct calculations show familiar and extra compact-universe waves form an exact pre-reduction accounting and carry nonzero currents in both parities, while the simplest Einstein embedding does not preserve the action-derived wave pairing; extra waves reach a Schwarzschild horizon, but finite symplectic size at infinity selects the familiar sector in both parities at one exact fixture
nodes.next: test corrected Einstein embeddings, generalize the infinity test in frequency and angular momentum, then build the scattering phase space and detectors

nodes.label: Clocks measure redshift
nodes.detail: an exact retarded example gives 1+z=2; the finite leading two-channel response stays independent throughout a tested clock-mass range
nodes.next: complete the all-wave response, one local frequency comparison, recoil and backreaction

nodes.label: Local emitters and detectors
nodes.detail: two dynamical sources create two distinct persistent records; the first retarded emitter channel and a finite mass-uniform leading response are exact
nodes.next: complete every spatial wave, nonlinear feedback and detector recoil

nodes.label: Quantum observables
nodes.detail: causal commutators for free curvature measurements are defined exactly
nodes.next: construct a physical quantum state and prove positivity

nodes.label: A physical quantum vacuum
nodes.detail: the required short-distance form is known locally, but no global state exists
nodes.next: construct a global state compatible with all gauge rules

nodes.label: Do quantum effects break the rules?
nodes.detail: the strict theory has a one-loop obstruction and a compensator repair; the ghost determinant has an exact spherical benchmark, generic local defect and all eleven integrated third-curvature functions
nodes.next: assemble the full ghost and physical metric determinants, then build the Lorentzian quantum theory

nodes.label: Gravitational lensing
nodes.detail: no complete local light-bending observable has been built yet
nodes.next: trace localized light through dynamical curvature

nodes.label: Where particle masses come from
nodes.detail: massive apparatus fields can be used, but the universe does not generate its own mass scale
nodes.next: build a stable mechanism that creates physical masses

nodes.label: The other forces and matter
nodes.detail: electromagnetism is present; strong, weak and chiral matter sectors are not
nodes.next: add strong-force, weak-force and fermion fields

nodes.label: Quantum particles and scattering
nodes.detail: a free observable algebra exists, but no physical particle state or scattering theory
nodes.next: add a quantum state, positivity and interactions

nodes.label: Black holes at rest
nodes.detail: a static family has regular horizons, energy, entropy and an exact first law
nodes.next: construct a time-dependent horizon phase space and connect it to the wave sector

nodes.label: Black holes with waves
nodes.detail: additional axial and polar waves are regular at the horizon, but at one exact frequency their reconstructed fields have infinite symplectic size at infinity, leaving only the Einstein-like waves in the finite-size class
nodes.next: prove the boundary classification for symbolic frequency and general angular momentum, then build exterior evolution, ringdown and stability

nodes.label: One theory for the matter forces
nodes.detail: no unified group or matter family has been selected
nodes.next: unify strong, weak and electromagnetic matter consistently

nodes.label: Galaxies and cosmic expansion
nodes.detail: no stable observational cosmology or dark sector has been built yet
nodes.next: build expanding solutions, lensing and matter phenomenology
